# TanStack Query

Server-state guidance for queries, mutations, caching, optimistic updates, SSR, persistence, testing, and all official adapters.

> The curated source is TanStack Query Intent draft PR #10879 until an npm skill package is released. Verify draft APIs against the installed Query version.

## Workflow

1. Inspect installed TanStack packages and exact versions.
2. Read the foundation reference and the adapter reference for the detected framework.
3. Read only the task topic that applies. Load another topic only across a real feature boundary.
4. Prefer installed package types and version-matched source guidance over memory.
5. Preserve headless/core behavior when translating examples to a framework adapter.

## Task routing

- [Foundations](references/foundations.md) — Client setup, keys, options, fetching, defaults, and abstractions.
- [Mutations and cache updates](references/mutations.md) — Mutations, invalidation, cancellation, and optimistic updates.
- [Data shaping](references/data-shaping.md) — Pagination, infinite queries, placeholders, selectors, and render efficiency.
- [Frameworks and UI state](references/frameworks-ui.md) — Adapter reactivity, status, errors, suspense, and devtools.
- [Routing and SSR](references/routing-ssr.md) — Router composition, prefetching, hydration, and streaming.
- [Offline and integrations](references/offline-integrations.md) — Persistence, broadcast, realtime, and form integration.
- [Quality and migration](references/quality.md) — Lint rules, tests, and major-version migration.

## Framework routing

- **React** — detect `@tanstack/react-query`. Read [Frameworks and UI state](references/frameworks-ui.md).
- **Preact** — detect `@tanstack/preact-query`. Read [Frameworks and UI state](references/frameworks-ui.md).
- **Vue** — detect `@tanstack/vue-query`. Read [Frameworks and UI state](references/frameworks-ui.md).
- **Solid** — detect `@tanstack/solid-query`. Read [Frameworks and UI state](references/frameworks-ui.md).

Most draft examples use React syntax. Read the Frameworks and UI State reference first, then translate only through the installed adapter.
